statements.text: While super intelligence brings unprecedented opportunity for the advancement of mission for the United States, it opens a large and volatile attack surface, which must be carefully and meticulously addressed.

statements.text: The National Security Agency’s Artificial Intelligence Security Center (AISC) is releasing the joint Cybersecurity Information Sheet (CSI), “AI Data Security: Best Practices for Securing Data Used to Train & Operate AI Systems,” to provide best practices and recommendations for the data security of AI systems.
